The '''''Jafan III''''' was a [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] passenger [[Starship/Legends|starship]] servicing [[Legislative Youth Program/Legends|Legislative Youth Program]] members during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] period.<ref name="Darth P" />

==History==
In [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], the ''Jafan III'' was in [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]] [[Hanna City Spaceport|Spaceport]], bound for [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Palpatine boarded the starship, and was comparing notes with a [[Unidentified Legislative Youth Program trainee|young trainee]] from [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] on their experiences on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] in the central passenger compartment, when a [[Unidentified Jafan III flight attendant|flight attendant]] informed him that someone had requested his presence in the starport terminal. Palpatine disembarked and was escorted to the [[Palpatine family starship]] by a [[Unidentified House Palpatine security guard|security guard]] working for [[Cosinga Palpatine|his father]], and the ''Jafan III'' left without him.<ref name="Darth P" />
